description: Phase471 primary holdout AUC cleared the predictive floor.
Best primary scenario had positive gross P&L but costs plus slippage were larger.
Best primary net P&L was negative after cost200 and Zerodha charges.
Best primary fixed-capital annualized return was below the 12% research profitability bar.
No primary threshold in the tested grid produced positive net P&L.
Phase472 did not allow direct expansion because profitability gates failed.
